Landlord | AI Engineer | Beaverton, OR | ONSITE | Full-time | $80k + stock options

Landlord builds AIs that turn people from builders into architects. This means our AIs hammer the nails (repetitive, boring tasks) so our customers can focus on what's really important at a high level.

Our niche is self-storage, and we have the best AIs for self-storage in the world. We're funded, growing crazy fast, and are looking for an engineer to work alongside our CTO in Oregon. The role is in person in Beaverton.

Watch a customer talk about our AI (James Bonny, Bonny's Self Storage): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XMg5FCX0k2M

How to apply: email careers@uselandlord.com with the subject "AI Engineer Application", something you've built with AI (link, photos and/or description), and your CV or LinkedIn URL.

Foji | Full Stack Engineer (TypeScript/React/Node) | Atlanta (hybrid) or REMOTE (US: Utah, Central or Eastern time) | Full-time | $110K–$140K + equity | https://foji.io

We automate the revenue cycle for dental practices: insurance eligibility and benefits, claim tracking, payment posting, and bank reconciliation. That means Playwright automation against insurance portals, AI agents that read benefits and remittance data, and deep integrations with practice software (Open Dental, Dentrix). We're profitable, growing fast, and small, so you'd own features end to end and work directly with me (CEO).

Looking for 3–5 years building production web apps.

Apply: https://wellfound.com/company/fojisoft/jobs

Kroo | Backend Software Engineer | NYC, Hybrid | Full-Time | $175k - $220k + equity + health benefits

Kroo is building the AI context layer for construction, an industry that badly needs solutions to solve their day-to-day headaches on the job-site. We’ve built a platform that our 50+ enterprise customers use to operate and maintain a data warehouse, and knowledge graphs specific to the nuances of the construction industry (think on-premises systems, archaic APIs, etc). Our customers, boots on the ground folks in the construction industry, use our software to gain insights, do work, and complete projects faster

We're looking for backend Software Engineers with 3+ YOE. We are a venture-backed, seed stage company with an experienced and hungry team. We’re backed by leading investors in the space and based in Midtown NYC (hybrid). If you’re looking to build in an industry that desperately needs data and AI solutions, apply here! https://app.loxo.co/job/MTA5OTQtOXlxejM5ZG9lY3Y2MjF0NQ==
